parameters.additivity_definition: One nonzero category per term: G1=BP; G3=CC; G7=MF. Not a sum across tests.

theme.continuous_provenance: Explicit original semantic extensions from selected base card; not an author-provided scale

provenance.source: Public authored drawing fixture; Complete selected frozen identities and supplied channels; no inference
provenance.input_unit: Explicit display records with declared physical or synthetic units
provenance.experimental_unit: No real biological independent units; no scientific inference
provenance.contrast: Declared illustrative comparison; preserve original values and complete selected scope
provenance.denominator: Every row of the exact frozen selected input table
provenance.limits: Software and visual demonstration, not biomedical evidence
provenance.uncertainty: Only supplied uncertainty channels; no interval estimation
provenance.interpretation_limit: Review new data, units, layout and intended display size separately
